headlines.title: Does Everforth (EFOR) Embedding Screening in Workday Deepen Its Consulting-Led Platform Strategy?
headlines.summary: In late September 2026, DISA Global Solutions announced the launch of its Built on Workday Pre-Employment Screening App, created with Workday-certified System Integrator Everforth TopBloc to embed background checks and drug testing directly into Workday Recruiting and streamline compliance-heavy hiring workflows.

headlines.title: The SaaSpocalypse is dead: Software stocks make a comeback
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi declares the so-called "SaaSpocalypse" dead and buried as software stocks stage a comeback.

headlines.title: Strada unveils Aon partnership and new AI-powered innovations ahead of Workday Rising U.S. 2026
headlines.summary: Strada, a people, payroll and technology leader that simplifies international workforce management and Workday Platinum Partner, today announces new alliances, innovations and expanded offerings at Workday Rising U.S. 2026, reflecting its continued investment in AI-powered solutions, proprietary tooling and expanded Workday capabilities.

headlines.title: Workday (WDAY) Extends Credit Access, Is It Still 66% Below Fair Value?
headlines.summary: Workday (WDAY) has expanded its revolving credit facility to US$1.5b and extended access through 2031, giving the software company more financial flexibility as its stock reacts to shifting earnings expectations. Recent trading tells a mixed story for Workday. The 90 day share price return of 35.16% points to building momentum, yet the year to date share price return of 8.74% lower and a 1 year total shareholder return that declined 21.

headlines.title: Workday (WDAY) Broadens Cash Cycle Automation For Finance Customers
headlines.summary: Workday (NasdaqGS:WDAY) partner Auditoria.AI announced broader autonomous Cash Cycle solutions for Workday finance users, including intelligent automation tools. The update adds finance-led governance features that aim to tighten controls and oversight inside Workday-based finance workflows. Auditoria.AI also reported new client wins and entry into additional international markets for its Workday-focused automation platform. This expansion of Auditoria.

description: Workday, Inc. provides enterprise cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company offers a suite of financial management applications to maintain accounting information; manage financial processes, such as payables and receivables; identify real-time financial, operational, and management insights; perform financial consolidation; reduce time-to-close; promote internal control and auditability; and achieve consistency across finance operations. It also provides spend management solutions that help organizations to streamline supplier selection and contract management, build and execute sourcing events, such as requests for proposals, and manage indirect spend; expense management solutions to submit and approve expenses; and a suite of human capital management applications that enables HR teams to hire, onboard, pay, develop, reskill, and provide employee experiences. In addition, the company offers planning applications. Further, it provides supply chain and inventory solutions to healthcare organizations; solutions to manage the end-to-end student and faculty lifecycle; Workday Extend for customers and their developers to build custom applications. The company serves the professional and business services, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, media, education, government, technology, media, retail, and hospitality industries. It sells its solutions through its direct sales organization. The company was formerly known as North Tahoe Power Tools, Inc. and changed its name to Workday, Inc. in July 2005. Workday, Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, California.
